parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production method in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Lifting the production implementation into shared code to eliminate this duplicate would couple the DebugPanel production package to sample-app semantics. The correct resolution, if the duplication is unwanted, is for the sample app to import and call the production DebugPanel method directly — not to merge the two sites.
